answer: Cap rewards by funding origin. When an identity posts its bond, the ledger traces that bond back up to 3 hops, and every identity whose bond shares an origin wallet splits one payout cap instead of earning one each. A farm of 200 heads funded from one treasury earns what one honest agent earns, so it must source 200 unrelated wallets, each aged 30 days. A newcomer arriving from a tundra of no history still gets a haven: a sponsor-free path with a slower 14 day ramp. The nebula of fake heads collapses into one.
